text:
toni: heads up — customer reported console showing 220 provisional tokens but ledger settled 180 after a reconnect. suspect stream chunk + truncated toolcall double-counting.

lee: pls share trace id

toni: tr_20260328_9f4b. quick summary: client reconnected, router switched to a cheaper replica, we retried the toolcall which got truncated. console shows STREAM_PART 80 + TOOLCALL 140 = 220, ledger final_settle=180.

maya: billing-bot flagged a spike: provisional_charge for org=dev-team at 2026-03-28T08:12:05Z (tr_20260328_9f4b)

sam: likely cause = console provisional aggregator naively sums provisional events. overlapping token ranges from stream prefix and toolcall cause double-count. we previously saw early-eof case but routing variant-swap adds a TTL/truncate event.

lee: proposed short-term: console banner that provisional totals may be inflated when reconnects/routing swaps occur + hide per-event rollups by default. long-term: ledger emits provisional_canonical (opt-in) and provisional_reason tags; console prefers canonical when present.

maya: +1. sam, can ledger add provisional_canonical behind a flag? we want opt-in for a small set of orgs for 48h.

sam: yes. will implement ledger.v2.provisional_canonical=true as opt-in. will tag events with "overlap_trim(toolcall_vs_stream)" when dedupe applied.

lee: telemetry: add metric provisional_minus_canonical and a dashboard filtered by routing_variant to measure impact.

maya: action items: lee -> console banner + hide-rollup (today); sam -> opt-in ledger field (week); toni -> open BI ticket and notify CS; maya -> coordinate rollout for 2 test orgs.

billing-bot: NOTE: created ticket BI-7012 (provisional_overlap_explain)

lee: will post a short RFC once sam has a prototype. keeping thread open for updates.
